data.one_liner: Dart extensions and helpers for maps, strings, collections, dates, async, and intl formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of extensions and utilities for everyday Dart development. It re-exports and unifies common APIs like convert_object, stringo, collection, and intl, allowing a single import to cover multiple helper libraries.
use_when: You want a single dependency that covers common map paths, string validations, collection helpers, and date/time manipulation.
You need debouncers, throttlers, and bounded concurrency helpers for asynchronous tasks.
You want advanced intl formatting shortcuts and URI manipulation utilities.
avoid_when: You only need a single isolated utility function and prefer to avoid pulling in an extensive extension pack.
Your project cannot meet the Dart 3.13.5 or later requirement.
strengths: Covers a massive range of everyday Dart needs under one import.
Re-exports essential packages like collection, intl, convert_object, and stringo.
Includes robust calendar-aware date helpers and stream/async transformers.
weaknesses: Large umbrella package that brings in many extensions you might not use.
Upgrading between major versions requires careful review of breaking renames and behavior changes.
